format: NDCA events: organizer adherence to advertised categories, dances and levels

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: The organizer must adhere to all categories, dances and levels specified in the promotional material.

requirement: For NDCA-profile events, an advertised round or category must not be cancelled or altered without a control tied to that material.
interpretation_notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Relevant to FUTURE NDCA round-cancellation controls only: cancel_competition_round (R12-DF-0006) is Studio/Custom policy with no link to promotional material. Public NDCA activation stays blocked on this. Not a Studio/Custom release gate.
